params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repo=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'HeavenBridgeRepo'; Set-Location $repo; git fetch origin main; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'git fetch failed'}; $d=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'HeavenBridgeMainVerify-104100'; git worktree add --detach $d origin/main; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'worktree add failed'}; try { python -m py_compile (Join-Path $d 'heaven-bridge\worker.py') (Join-Path $d 'heaven-bridge\test_worker.py') (Join-Path $d 'heaven-bridge\tests\test_worker.py'); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'py_compile failed'}; python (Join-Path $d 'heaven-bridge\test_worker.py'); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "primary tests failed: $LASTEXITCODE"}; python (Join-Path $d 'heaven-bridge\tests\test_worker.py'); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "compat tests failed: $LASTEXITCODE"}; foreach($p in @('bootstrap.ps1','manage.ps1')){ $tokens=$null; $errors=$null; [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile((Join-Path $d ('heaven-bridge\'+$p)),[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errors); if($errors.Count){ throw ($errors | Out-String) } }; Write-Output 'MAIN_BRIDGE_VERIFY_OK'; git -C $d rev-parse HEAD } finally { Set-Location $repo; git worktree remove --force $d; git worktree prune }
